title: Prime
summary: Modernizing legacy index generation system to support thousands of real-time and EOD indices.
description:
Modernization of a legacy system used to compute and deliver hundreds of financial indices. Working within the FTSE Russell team on **real-time** and **end-of-day** index computation pipelines.

### What I did
- Migrated core calculation engine to the latest .NET stack
- Reduced daily file generation time by 35%. Using Multi-Threading to process files in parallel. 
- Improved fault tolerance across EOD batch runs
- Collaborated with global quant teams to validate index accuracy

title: Mark Smart Credit
summary: Cloud-native financial microservices platform on Azure with Kubernetes-based deployment and FinOps governance.
description:
End-to-end migration and modernization of a critical credit marking platform used across Societe Generale's trading operations.

### What I did
- Migrated .NET Framework services to .NET Core and deployed on **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)**
- Introduced caching and async processing with message queues for efficient resource usage
- Reduced cloud infrastructure costs by **30** through FinOps tagging and right-sizing
- Built CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and ArgoCD with zero-downtime rolling deployments
- Integrated Azure Databricks and Data Lake for analytics workloads. 
- Streamlined the CI/CD by automating the workflows for vulnerability and code coverage analysis.

title: My Wall Dashboard
summary: Trade simulation widgets with embedded pre-deal financial checks and high-performance dynamic rendering.
description:
Built a suite of interactive trading widgets embedded in the internal dealer dashboard, used by hundreds of traders daily.

### What I did
- Developed pre-deal financial check widgets that surface risk signals before order submission
- Implemented lazy loading and dynamic rendering — cut initial load time by **40%**
- Used **Preact** for performance-critical widget surfaces alongside the main React shell
- Set up **Storybook** for component documentation and visual regression testing

title: Algo Referential
summary: API and audit layer for algorithm repository management supporting governance and compliance teams.
description:
Governance tool for managing the lifecycle of trading algorithms — from creation and versioning through compliance sign-off and deployment.

### What I did
- Designed and built RESTful APIs for algorithm CRUD and version management
- Implemented a full audit trail layer to support compliance and regulatory reporting
- Integrated different Systems to get the details of Running Algorithm

title: Adaptive Learning Management System
summary: AI-driven assessments and analytics platform improving learner engagement and personalizing learning paths.
description:
A project exploring adaptive learning — a platform that adjusts the difficulty and topic sequence of assessments based on learner performance.

### What I did
- Built the full-stack application using React and Node.js on Firebase
- Designed an adaptive assessment engine that scores responses and reorders question sets in real time
- Integrated Firestore for real-time sync of learner progress across devices
